summary: Nicola Mining Inc. filed a Form 6-K (a US Form 8-K equivalent for foreign private issuers) attaching an October 8, 2026 news release announcing that Lower Nicola Site Services exercised its option to extend the Rock and Gravel Extraction and Preferential Engagement Agreement, originally signed March 2022, through March 3, 2033. Nicola receives a per-tonne royalty on gravel and rock extracted at the Craigmont Mine Site. Nicola also reported completing its first diamond drill program at the Treasure Mountain MB Zone, four holes totaling about 800 metres, with assays pending. No special-situation transaction is involved.
